snippet.title: Voidwood - Playtest Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

In this 1–4 player co-op survival horror game, you and your friends are children trapped in a cursed forest. By day, you scavenge and push deeper. By night, you hide from The Beast, which tracks every sound you make, so your voice can save your friends or give everyone away. From Santa Barbara Games, coming to Steam in 2027.
